packageRules.description: ansible_molecule_ansible_version installs the molecule control node on the CI test nodes, one of which (debian-bookworm) ships system Python 3.11. ansible >=13 requires Python >=3.12, so bumps to 13/14 cannot install there and red the whole buildset. Cap at <13 until every molecule node provides Python 3.12 (drop bookworm or install 3.12 there).
